Home.title: Authgear CLOUD - Your Managed IAM Solution
Home.description: Authgear makes it easier for developers to meet complex authentication requirements, delivering a frictionless and exceptional digital experience.
Home.heroParagraph: Enjoy the convenience of a SaaS platform with enterprise-grade security, high availability, and tailored support. Authgear Cloud simplifies identity management so you can focus on growing your business.
Home.growthSubheading: Unlock the power of secure and effortless authentication.
Home.growthCard1Desc: Offer a variety of login options, including modern methods like biometrics, to create a seamless and convenient experience for your users. This fosters trust and engagement, driving user growth.
Home.growthCard2Desc: Our low-code solution streamlines the authentication process, allowing you to integrate robust security features with minimal development effort.
Home.growthCard3Desc: Customize features to meet your specific requirements and security standards. Plus, the solution scales effortlessly as your business grows, ensuring continued security without needing to overhaul your system.
Home.growthCard4Desc: Authgear caters to a wide range of business needs, from B2C customer accounts to complex B2B user hierarchies. Customize Authgear to fit your specific requirements and security needs. Scale effortlessly as your business grows.
Home.ciamHeading:
Secure Every User Journey with
Authgear's Tailored Solutions
Home.ciamSubheading: Authgear delivers robust CIAM solutions designed to meet the specific needs of your business.
Home.ciamCard1Desc: Simplify user management and secure your customer accounts. Ideal for e-commerce, social media platforms, and any service that relies on secure user logins.
Home.ciamCard2Desc: Manage access for a complex user base with employees, partners, vendors, and contractors. Authgear streamlines access control and ensures secure collaboration within your organization.
Home.ciamCard3Desc: Deliver a secure and customizable authentication experience for each client organization within your SaaS platform. Authgear empowers you to scale securely without compromising on user experience.
Home.microservicesHeading:
A Core Component of
Your Microservices Architecture
Home.microservicesSubheading: Authgear is a centralized identity management solution for your microservices architecture.
Home.microCard1Desc: Maintain a unified user identity across all microservices, preventing fragmentation of user data and access rights.
Home.microCard2Desc: Enable features like Single Sign-On (SSO) across multiple microservices, providing a seamless and convenient experience for your users.
Home.microCard3Desc: Centralize authentication and authorization, making it easier to track and monitor access attempts across your entire system.
Home.zeroTrustSubheading: Authgear aligns with zero-trust principles by enforcing "never trust, always verify" for every request.
Home.zeroTrustCard1Desc: Issue JWT access tokens to microservices, ensuring that only authorized entities can access resources.
Home.zeroTrustCard2Desc: Enforce fine-grained access controls based on user roles, permissions, and context.
Home.zeroTrustCard3Desc: Minimize the exposure of credential information by using JWT tokens and avoiding storing sensitive data in microservices.
Home.buildFasterHeading:
Security Shouldn't Slow You Down.
Build Secure Apps Faster with Authgear.
Home.buildFasterSubheading: In today's digital landscape, secure user authentication is no longer a luxury - it's a necessity. Here's why businesses of all sizes need a solution like Authgear:
Home.buildFasterCard1Desc: Cyberattacks are on the rise, and traditional login methods are increasingly vulnerable. Authgear provides robust security features to protect your users and data from breaches and unauthorized access.
Home.buildFasterCard2Desc: Secure logins are essential for building trust with your users. Authgear empowers you to offer a safe and reliable user experience, fostering loyalty and engagement.
Home.buildFasterCard3Desc: Managing complex user accounts across different user groups can be time-consuming. Authgear streamlines user management and access control, saving you time and resources.
Home.buildFasterCard4Desc: Go beyond basic passwords! Authgear offers a variety of login options, including biometrics, for a smooth and convenient user journey. This reduces login friction and improves user satisfaction.
Home.buildFasterCard5Desc: Authgear adapts to your business needs. Our solution scales effortlessly as you grow, and integrates seamlessly with your existing infrastructure.
Home.enterpriseTrustSubheading: We understand local needs. Authgear Cloud offers dedicated, region-specific support, ensuring your IAM solution is always optimized for your business.

Home.storyHKLDesc: Hongkong Land adopted Authgear to meet strict security requirements with zero trust authentication, while enabling seamless access for both staff and agents. This reduced IT workload and secured mobile-ready login across user groups.

MultiFactorAuthentication.heroTitle: Adaptive MFA: Stronger security, less friction
MultiFactorAuthentication.heroDescription: Authgear adapts MFA challenges to context so you cut account takeovers without bloating every sign-in.
MultiFactorAuthentication.whatIsDescription: Multi-factor authentication (MFA) is a security method that requires users to provide two or more forms of identification to gain access to a system or account. It's like adding an extra lock to your digital door for enhanced protection.
MultiFactorAuthentication.adaptiveMfaDescription: Adaptive MFA selectively prompts for stronger factors (passkeys, TOTP, OTP) based on risk rather than always-on MFA for everyone. Pair it with Authgear's built-in rate limits, CAPTCHA, and account lockout for layered defense.
MultiFactorAuthentication.uxDescription: A login experience that stays fast and intuitive, even when extra security steps are needed.
MultiFactorAuthentication.ux1: Challenge only when needed; keep everyday logins fast
MultiFactorAuthentication.ux2: Pre-built OTP/MFA screens and settings page reduce confusion and support tickets
MultiFactorAuthentication.devDescription: Built to help developers ship quickly and customize authentication as needs grow.
MultiFactorAuthentication.dev1: Ship fast with Web, iOS, Android, RN, Flutter SDKs and an Admin API
MultiFactorAuthentication.dev2: Tune flows with Custom Auth Flow and extend logic with Hooks

Authorization.heroDescription: Fine-grained access control built for your users, teams and products
Authorization.whyAuthgearDescLine1: With growing user bases and complex apps, managing who can do what is critical.
Authorization.whyAuthgearDescLine2: Roles & Groups let you shift from per-user permissions to a scalable model where you manage roles once, then assign at scale.
Authorization.centralizedTitle: Centralized Authorization with Roles and Groups
Authorization.rolesDesc: Define roles and assign roles to users directly. Roles are included in UserInfo / JWT claims so your app has the context to enforce permissions.
Authorization.groupsDesc: Create groups that bundle one or more roles. Add users to groups; they inherit the roles of that group. Simplifies bulk-permission management.
Authorization.auditDesc: Manage roles/groups and see who has what role in a central place. Position for governance, compliance and least-privilege access as you scale.

SmsPumpingFraud.heroTitle: Protect Your Business from SMS Pumping Fraud
SmsPumpingFraud.heroDescription: Safeguard your SMS authentication channels from costly fraud with Authgear's advanced SMS Pumping Detection. Our intelligent system identifies suspicious patterns and stops attacks before they drain your budget.
SmsPumpingFraud.threatTitle: The Hidden Threat of SMS Pumping Fraud
SmsPumpingFraud.threatDescription: SMS pumping fraud is a sophisticated attack where bad actors exploit SMS-based authentication systems by generating excessive message traffic using fake or automated phone numbers. This artificial traffic inflation can cost businesses millions in fraudulent charges while degrading legitimate user experiences.
SmsPumpingFraud.caseStudyTitle: The Twitter Case Study: A $60 Million Lesson
SmsPumpingFraud.caseStudyDescription: In late 2022, Elon Musk revealed that Twitter was losing approximately $60 million annually due to SMS pumping fraud. The fraud was traced to 390 telecom operators that allowed bot accounts to exploit Twitter's two-factor authentication system, generating fake SMS traffic to inflate their own revenue. This costly revelation highlights how even tech giants can fall victim to this growing threat.
SmsPumpingFraud.financialDrainDesc: SMS pumping attacks can rapidly deplete your messaging budget with fraudulent traffic. Companies hit by these atacks often pay between tens of thousands to millions of dollars each month in fake charges. When bad actors pump your website forms with fake numbers, your SMS costs increase significantly without any return on investment.
SmsPumpingFraud.operationalDesc: Beyond direct costs, SMS pumping creates cascading problems throughout your business:
SmsPumpingFraud.listItem1Sub: Surges in fraudulent traffic can overwhelm your authentication infrastructure
SmsPumpingFraud.listItem2Sub: Legitimate users face delays receiving their authentication codes
SmsPumpingFraud.listItem3Sub: Your metrics become artificially deflated as fake "users" never convert
SmsPumpingFraud.listItem4Sub: Your team spends valuable time investigating and addressing the fraud
SmsPumpingFraud.reputationDesc: When authentication systems fail due to SMS pumping attacks, users lose trust in your platform. This erosion of confidence can have lasting impacts on your brand reputation and customer loyalty.
SmsPumpingFraud.warningSectionDesc: Without proper monitoring tools, SMS pumping can be difficult to detect until significant damage is done. Here are key indicators that your business might be under attack:
SmsPumpingFraud.warning1Desc: If you notice OTP requests coming from regions or countries where you don't normally operate, this could signal fraudulent activity. Pay attention to successful OTP attempts from locations where you don't have a legitimate customer base.
SmsPumpingFraud.warning2Desc: Sudden, unexplained surges in SMS traffic—especially for OTP requests—often indicate bot activity. Unless you're running a promotion or campaign, these spikes warrant immediate investigation.
SmsPumpingFraud.warning3Desc: One telltale sign of SMS pumping is receiving OTP requests from phone numbers with sequential patterns (e.g., numbers ending in 1000, 1001, 1002). The chance of multiple people with nearly identical phone numbers requesting OTPs simultaneously is virtually zero.
SmsPumpingFraud.warning4Desc: A noticeable drop in OTP conversion rates can indicate that fraudsters are sending requests without completing the authentication process. If your typical conversion rate falls by 20% or more, SMS pumping could be the culprit.
SmsPumpingFraud.warning5Desc: If you're burning through your SMS budget faster than usual, it's likely that SMS pumping is affecting your business. This is often the most painful symptom that finally triggers investigation.
SmsPumpingFraud.solutionDesc: Our advanced detection system uses machine learning algorithms to identify and block fraudulent SMS traffic before it impacts your business. Unlike basic security measures, our solution provides comprehensive protection against sophisticated SMS pumping attacks.
SmsPumpingFraud.feature1Desc: Our system continuously analyzes your SMS traffic patterns to detect anomalies that indicate potential fraud attempts.
SmsPumpingFraud.feature2Desc: Advanced algorithms identify suspicious behaviors such as sequential number requests, geographic anomalies, and unusual traffic spikes.
SmsPumpingFraud.feature3Desc: When potential fraud is detected, our system automatically alerts administrators and takes immediate action to prevent further damage.
SmsPumpingFraud.feature4Desc: Detect bots and abnormal clients with advanced, privacy-respecting techniques such as JA4 fingerprinting and PoW challenges to create a custom blocklist and rate limit policy
SmsPumpingFraud.feature5Desc: Gain visibility into your SMS traffic with comprehensive reporting and visualization tools.
SmsPumpingFraud.why1Desc: Authgear's SMS Pumping Detection is part of our holistic security ecosystem that includes multi-factor authentication, breached password detection, and bot protection. This integrated approach provides defense-in-depth against evolving threats.
SmsPumpingFraud.why2Desc: Our solution integrates smoothly with your existing authentication infrastructure, requiring minimal changes to your current setup.
SmsPumpingFraud.why3Desc: While enhancing security, we maintain a frictionless authentication experience for legitimate users, ensuring protection doesn't come at the cost of usability.
SmsPumpingFraud.why4Desc: By preventing fraudulent SMS traffic, our solution helps you avoid unexpected charges and protect your authentication budget.
SmsPumpingFraud.ctaDesc: Don't wait until SMS pumping fraud impacts your bottom line. Request a demo today for Authgear's SMS Pumping Detection and implement this powerful protection for your business.
SmsPumpingFraud.ctaGetStarted: Get started today! Free trials available.
